name: Apex Solventless | 1g Live Rosin Tier S | Papaya (73-119u)
description:
Papaya is a very special cut of the cannabis plant that produces rosin reminiscent of its tropical namesake! From the moment the owners Parker and Alex first tried Papaya rosin, they were hooked, and went on a hunt to find the tastiest cut of the strain they could! Our cut of Papaya was gifted to Apex by an old time hash head that swears by the sun and soil, this is the original Papaya cut. Dripped out in decadent Hawaiian fruit terps, combined with a rotten backend, this cut is well deserving of its Select Tier status.

Cross: Jack Herer x Skunk #1

Terp Profile: Tropical, Mango, Skunk
